text: The initiative trained over 19,900 local officials, advanced local legal frameworks and disaster management committees, increased municipal DRR budgets, mapped over 130,000 buildings, and involved 6,000 volunteers in mapping 80% of affected areas post-2015 quake. It also facilitated operational coordination during COVID-19 and the 2023 Jajarkot earthquake, and approved reconstruction for the 2079 Doti earthquake.

metadata.solution_name: Nepal’s Government-led Earthquake Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives (2020–2025)
